evidence_weighed: Paper02: ED0014 line 1796 and the adjacent identity theta_eta^2 ~ -1/3(...) force the substituted reduction term to be +1/3; the later genuinely negative relation remains unchanged.
Paper08: ED0014 line 6043, the accepted checker packet, and primary-page witness require rational c_1,c_2, not rational-integer theta_1,theta_2.
Paper22: ED0014 lines 12839-12843 and the primary-page witness bind B_lambda throughout the lambda-indexed filtration; B_i is incoherent at the selected locus.

Paper34: ED0014 lines 18065-18069 require W_nu, name l_nu twice, and specify a simple left ideal; an independent legacy scan agrees. The curated German witness is itself defective here and is retained only as adverse evidence.
The live German pointer is byte-identical to the activated r33 pointer for NOETH-DE-ED-0014, version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21908301; all 53 files passed anonymous SHA-256 readback.
